page.layout: One column of text: centred heading above a single paragraph with a large initial. No marginal notes, running head, page number or catchword. The faint mirrored title, date and ornament are show-through and not transcribed.

main_text.head: Typographus Lectori.
main_text.p: CUm haec P. Rami Basilea Basileæ scripta forté in nostras manus incidisset, eam maluimus illo inscio prælo committi, quæ adferret tibi nihil adiumenti, quam veluti sepultam in tenebris delitescere. Quam-obrem nostrum hoc in te studium & operam boni consulite.

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Um", read as CUm. The word after "quam" in "quæ adferret" is hard to distinguish from "que" at this scan resolution; it is written as quæ. Possible show-through of the title "PETRI RAMI BASILEA AD SENAM ... Basiliensem" and of the date "M.D.LXXI" appears mirrored at the top and bottom and was left out.
